public_open_record.description: Safe for public-facing semantic outputs for free and open icons.

protected_premium_record.description: Uses the same record shape but stays out of public outputs by default.

private_operational_enrichment.description: Internal operational signals and editorial notes that never flow into public outputs by default.

future_public_record.description: Keep internal visibility and allow future public-safe projections.

internal_only.description: Keep the record in internal previews only.

public_summary.description: Allow public-safe summaries without assuming full public record output yet.

mcp_preview.description: Allow an internal preview plus a future MCP-facing summary path.
